name: House of Seclusion
source:
A visual novel inspired by the Harem Conspiracy against Ramses III and the fragmentary Middle Egyptian text The Tale of the Herdsman.

[From [url=https://calygreyhound.itch.io/house-of-seclusion]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部视觉小说，灵感来自反对拉美西斯三世的后宫阴谋和零散的中古埃及文本《牧人的故事》。

[来自[url=https://calygreyhound.itch.io/house-of-seclusion]Itch.io[/url]]
